project_type: SvelteKit 5 monorepo, TypeScript strict, Supabase, Vercel deployment
build_system: Vite + @sveltejs/adapter-vercel. Build: npm run build. Dev: npm run dev. Type-check: npm run check (runs svelte-kit sync + svelte-check).
test_framework: vitest (npm run test). Playwright for e2e (npm run test:e2e). No existing unit tests for campaign routes — verify via npm run check.
verification_instructions: Run `npm run check` after every file change to confirm zero TypeScript/Svelte errors. The project has no unit tests for API routes, so type-checking is the primary verification gate.
environment_constraints: Windows workspace (powershell). Paths use backslashes in terminal but forward slashes in code. Do NOT push to git — implement locally only. All new files go under c:\Users\hp\OneDrive\Documents\bulkEmail\src\.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing patterns: requireSession try/catch for auth, json() returns, zod for request body validation on POST, use locals.supabase for user-scoped queries, createSupabaseAdminClient for storage operations and RLS-bypass writes.
key_patterns: API route pattern: import { json } from '@sveltejs/kit'; import { requireSession } from '$lib/server/auth/session'; export const POST: RequestHandler = async ({ locals, params }) => { let session; try { session = requireSession(locals); } catch { return json({ success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 }); } ... }. Storage uploads always use createSupabaseAdminClient (imported from '$lib/server/db/supabase'). Campaign sub-routes all live under src/routes/api/campaigns/[id]/<name>/+server.ts. Svelte wizard uses $state runes, no stores.
directory_structure: src/routes/api/campaigns/ — campaign REST API. src/routes/api/campaigns/[id]/ — per-campaign actions (cancel, pause, resume, start, report). src/routes/(app)/dashboard/campaigns/new/ — wizard page. src/lib/server/ — server-side services (auth, db, smtp, documents). src/lib/components/ui/ — shared UI components (Card, Button, VariablePicker).
